ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with approximately 15% high-intensity (white) distribution concentrated in linear scars and marginal calcifications.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark pigmentation across central and lateral lobe surfaces; high-contrast linear markings on the inner-right lobe; clustered white/tan circular formations on distal tips and trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch, estimated at 45 degrees, base partially obscured by water spray pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency peaks (2-12 pixels) caused by natural serration and barnacle encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Right lobe follows a convex arc to the distal tip; left lobe presents a more linear, upward-sloping trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed circular high-contrast clusters (barnacles) on the far-left tip and upper-right margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 3-4 parallel, high-contrast linear scratches (rake marks) on the ventral surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization causing significant alteration to the natural trailing edge silhouette.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible water spray and cavitation at the fluke-water interface.
